### 1 — Scene
A chicken-and-vegetable dish over white rice, with a side of mixed fruit and a glass of orange juice. The chicken appears coated in a glossy brown sauce.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 26 cm diameter; area ≈ **531 cm²**.
- **Fruit bowl:** approximately 18 cm diameter; area ≈ **254 cm²**.
- **Juice glass:** approximately 6 cm internal diameter; cross-sectional area ≈ **28 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods appear to be white rice, chicken pieces, green beans, carrots, mushrooms, brown sauce, watermelon, orange/yellow melon, green grapes, and orange juice. Any cooking oil is included in the sauce estimate rather than counted separately.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas are allocated without double-counting overlapping ingredients. Heights represent approximate average pile thicknesses.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| White rice | 20% of plate | 106 × 1.4 = 148 ml | 0.8 | 119 g | 130 | 155 kcal |
| Chicken | 18% | 96 × 1.3 = 125 ml | 0.95 | 119 g | 175 | 208 kcal |
| Green beans, carrots, mushrooms | 14% | 74 × 1.4 = 104 ml | 0.6 | 62 g | 35 | 22 kcal |
| Brown sauce, including cooking fat | 4% | 21 × 0.9 = 19 ml | 1.0 | 19 g | 150 | 29 kcal |
| Watermelon | 30% of fruit bowl | 76 × 1.8 = 137 ml | 0.6 | 82 g | 30 | 25 kcal |
| Orange/yellow melon | 20% | 51 × 1.8 = 92 ml | 0.6 | 55 g | 35 | 19 kcal |
| Green grapes | 15% | 38 × 1.8 = 68 ml | 0.6 | 41 g | 69 | 28 kcal |
| Orange juice | 100% of glass cross-section | 28 × 9 = 252 ml | 1.04 | 262 g | 45 | 118 kcal |

**Coverage check:** main plate approximately **56%**, fruit bowl approximately **65%**—consistent with the visible empty rims.

### 8 — Sanity check
The main dish totals approximately **319 g**, fruit **178 g**, and juice **262 g**. That gives approximately **759 g and 604 kcal including the drink**, or **497 g and 486 kcal for the solid food**. These are plausible for the visible portions; sauce composition and hidden rice introduce the most uncertainty.
